notes.title: S.O.R.S patch v1.01 live
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I’ve pushed a quick update to improve a couple of gameplay aspects based on player feedback:

1. Lifestyle advice: I’ve removed some of the more ambiguous items so this first stage should be fairer and less based on guesswork

2. Osteoporosis/Diabetes graph marks: added text describing what you need to look for on the graph itself. Hopefully this should make it easier to work out what patterns you need to look for.

That’s it for now. Thanks a lot for your support and keep that feedback coming. 


Rich
